title: stelis ferrelliae
intro: Stelis ferrelliae, commonly known as the orchid Stelis, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the orchid family (Orchidaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Stelis ferrelliae include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress, with its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
